_comment: Arm B2 manifest. Hints include workflow guidance: when in the task to fetch each section. Reflects what a Planner-tier authored manifest would ship.

hints.meta: Task title, project name, priority. Fetch first.
hints.scope: One-paragraph framing. Fetch first to ground yourself.
hints.stack: Runtime, framework, test deps, npm scripts. Fetch before writing package.json or src/server.js.
hints.directory_layout: File tree. Fetch early to know what to create.
hints.data_models: User shape and request/response shapes. Fetch before writing src/routes/users.js.
hints.endpoints: REST routes. Fetch before writing any src/routes/*.js or tests/server.test.js.
hints.style: Code conventions. Fetch before writing any .js source file.
hints.testing: vitest + supertest patterns and required test cases. Fetch ONLY before writing tests/server.test.js.
hints.readme_outline: README section structure. Fetch ONLY before writing README.md.
hints.success_criteria: Graded checklist. Fetch before calling mark_complete to self-verify.
